answer.short: Top circle: $-2$; bottom left: $10$; bottom right: $-10$.
answer.worked:
The bottom circles are $10$ and $-10$, with midpoint $0$. Put $-2$ at the top, $10$ at the bottom left and $-10$ at the bottom right. Check each rectangle:
$$\begin{align*}
(-2+10)\div2&=4\\
(-2+(-10))\div2&=-6\\
(10+(-10))\div2&=0.
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upright triangular puzzle with three writable circles and two larger writable rectangles on the left and bottom connections. The smaller fixed rectangle on the right connection contains −55. Ordinary outlines are black; white interiors mask connectors and provide unshaded writing areas.

answer.short: Two solutions: top circle $-10$, left rectangle $-30$, bottom-left circle $-50$, bottom rectangle $-75$, bottom-right circle $-100$; or top circle $-100$, left rectangle $-75$, bottom-left circle $-50$, bottom rectangle $-30$, bottom-right circle $-10$.
answer.worked:
The right-hand circle pair must be $-10$ and $-100$, whose midpoint is $-55$. With $-50$ in the bottom-left circle, either order of that pair completes the puzzle.

First arrangement: top $-10$, bottom left $-50$, bottom right $-100$; left rectangle $-30$, bottom rectangle $-75$.
$$\begin{align*}
(-10+(-100))\div2&=-55\\
(-10+(-50))\div2&=-30\\
(-50+(-100))\div2&=-75.
\end{align*}$$
Second arrangement: top $-100$, bottom left $-50$, bottom right $-10$; left rectangle $-75$, bottom rectangle $-30$.
$$\begin{align*}
(-100+(-10))\div2&=-55\\
(-100+(-50))\div2&=-75\\
(-50+(-10))\div2&=-30.
\end{align*}$$
